# ui::IconSource

Header: `winui/render/IconSource.hpp`.

An icon as a value: a glyph, a symbol, a path or a picture, held by whatever shows an icon without hosting it as a child element.

Every control that shows an icon takes one in its `icon` field, and [`ui::Icon`](../controls/icon.md#uiicon) shows one on its own. Copyable and cheap to pass around. A [Symbol](namespace-ui.md#symbol), an [IconGlyph](icon-glyph.md) and an [ImageSource](image-source.md) (a [Bitmap](bitmap.md), an SVG document or an animated image) convert to it implicitly; a path or a monochrome bitmap is made with [path()](#path) and [bitmap()](#bitmap). A default-constructed IconSource is empty and draws nothing.

A control draws it with [draw_in_slot()](#draw_in_slot): a glyph at the slot's glyph size, anything else fitted into the same square, so every kind of icon takes the room a glyph would.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::IconSource save_icon = ui::Symbol::Save;                            // a symbol
ui::IconSource share     = ui::IconGlyph{0xE72D};                       // a font glyph
ui::IconSource sigma     = ui::IconGlyph{0x03A3, "Candara", 20.0f};     // another font
ui::IconSource arrow     = ui::IconSource::path(*ui::PathGeometry::parse("F1 M 20,20L 24,10L 24,24L 5,24"));
ui::IconSource logo      = ui::IconSource::bitmap(ui::Bitmap::read_png("logo.png"));

window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .primary = {
        ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Save", .icon = save_icon, .on_click = [] { save(); }},
        ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Share", .icon = share},
    },
});

// Drawing one yourself, from a render_override():
share.measure(measurer); // a glyph's box is measured (and cached) before draw()
share.draw(renderer, ui::Rect{0, 0, 20, 20}, theme.palette.text_fill_primary);
```

## IconSource

```cpp
IconSource() = default
```

No icon (a null IconSource).

## IconSource

```cpp
IconSource(IconGlyph glyph)
```

One glyph at `glyph.size` in `glyph.font_family`.

## IconSource

```cpp
IconSource(Symbol symbol)
```

The symbol's Segoe Fluent Icons glyph at 20px.

## IconSource

```cpp
template <typename P>
IconSource(P&& picture)
    requires std::convertible_to<P&&, ImageSource>
```

The picture as it is, from an [ImageSource](image-source.md) or anything that converts to one (a [Bitmap](bitmap.md), an SVG document, an animated image); the same as [image()](#image).

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const
```

True for a null IconSource (nothing to draw).

## operator bool

```cpp
operator bool() const
```

True when there is an icon; `!empty()`.

## glyph

```cpp
const IconGlyph* glyph() const
```

The glyph for a font or symbol icon, else null. Points into this IconSource.

## measure

```cpp
Size measure(const TextMeasurer& measurer) const
```

The icon's own size before any [ScaleToFit](../layout/scale-to-fit.md#uiscaletofit) scales it. A glyph is measured with `measurer` and the result kept for [draw()](#draw); everything else ignores it. Safe to call from a layout worker while another thread draws the same icon.

## draw

```cpp
void draw(Renderer& renderer, const Rect& box, const Color& foreground) const
```

Draws the icon into `box` as a Uniform [ScaleToFit](../layout/scale-to-fit.md#uiscaletofit) would: its natural size scaled to fit and centered. `foreground` colors a glyph, a path and a monochrome bitmap; a picture keeps its own colors. Copies of one IconSource may be drawn on several threads at once.

## draw_in_slot

```cpp
void draw_in_slot(Renderer& renderer, const Rect& box, const Color& foreground, float size = 0.0f, std::string_view symbol_font = {}) const
```

Draws the icon in a control's icon slot of `size` DIPs, centered in `box`: a glyph at `size` as [draw_icon()](namespace-ui.md#draw_icon) draws it, anything else fitted into a `size` square as [draw()](#draw) does. A `size` of 0 is the glyph's own size, and fits anything else into `box`. `symbol_font`, when not empty, replaces the default symbol font of a glyph that names it (a theme's `icon_font_family`); a glyph from another font keeps its own.

## slot_size

```cpp
Size slot_size(float size = 0.0f) const
```

The room [draw_in_slot()](#draw_in_slot) takes for `size`: a `size` square; for a `size` of 0 the glyph's own square, or the natural size of anything else.

## extent

```cpp
float extent(float fallback) const
```

The slot size a control gives this icon: a glyph's own size, or `fallback` for anything else (a control's icon size, so a picture takes the room a glyph would).

## path

```cpp
static IconSource path(PathGeometry data)
```

A path icon drawing `data`.

## bitmap

```cpp
static IconSource bitmap(Bitmap image, bool monochrome = true)
```

The picture, recolored to the foreground while `monochrome` (true by default). The foreground's RGB is drawn over the picture's own alpha.

## image

```cpp
static IconSource image(ImageSource source)
```

The picture as it is (an animated one shows its first frame).
